en.title: Doc comments for the World3D exports
en.body: The 338 exports of World3D, its WebGL2 and WebGPU entries and `play3d` that had no sentence in the sources now have one, so editors show what each is and the API reference says it. Of the engine's 1329 exports, 2 are still silent: `EngineOptions`, whose declaration file is held to its size, `EventListenerOptions`, whose comment would change a recorded compiler message.

zh.title: World3D 导出补齐说明
zh.body: World3D 及其 WebGL2、WebGPU 入口和 `play3d` 中 338 个在源码里没有说明的导出补上了一句说明，编辑器悬停和 API 参考都能看到。引擎 1329 个导出中只剩 2 个没有说明：`EngineOptions`（其声明文件大小被固定）、`EventListenerOptions`（加注释会改变已记录的编译器信息）。
